name: Differentiable Voxelization from Radiative Gaussians
definition: A differentiable voxelizer V to efficiently query a density volume $V \in R^{X \times Y \times Z}$ from radiative Gaussians, used for 3D regularization.
summary: Differentiable Voxelization from Radiative Gaussians efficiently converts continuous Gaussian splats into a discrete 3D density volume using spatial tiling and culling, enabling differentiable tomographic reconstruction.
